paragraphs.text: Sleeps four. Beside a river, two miles from the nearest village. Dogs welcome (maximum two). There is a wood-burning stove, and logs are provided free of charge. Minimum stay three nights.
Sleeps eight. In the centre of the village, close to shops and a pub. Large garden with play equipment. Not suitable for pets. Available for weekly bookings only, Saturday to Saturday.

Sleeps two. A first-floor flat with a balcony overlooking the harbour. There is no parking, but a public car park is five minutes’ walk away. Short breaks available all year. Bed linen and towels are provided.
Sleeps six. A converted barn with wide views across the valley. Electric car charging point. Please note that the track to the barn is steep and unsuitable for low cars.
Sleeps four. Ground-floor bedroom and bathroom, suitable for guests with limited mobility. Ten minutes’ drive to the beach. Free Wi-Fi and a welcome basket of local food.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Look at the five holiday cottages, A–E. Which cottage mentions the following? Write the correct letter, A–E. NB You may use any letter more than once.
